changelog:
Initial release of huo15-claw-butler-file-delivery.

- Enables delivering files directly to the user's 龙虾管家 (Claw Butler) desktop or mobile client.
- Uses the client's reliable file.push node capability, avoiding file delivery failures in WebChat.
- Supports both small files (base64 in message) and large files (via external URL).
- Triggers on common user requests for files and when standard file sending fails with "Message failed" or 404 links.
- Includes usage guidelines and best practices to ensure successful delivery.
summary: Deliver files (report, PDF, image, spreadsheet, archive, code) to 龙虾管家 client via file.push node, avoiding failed WebChat file sends.
